title: Rollback to Version 22 – Fix account recognition and registration errors

requirements.summary: Roll back frontend to Version 22 state to restore stable account recognition and registration behavior
acceptanceCriteria: Existing users who previously created an account are recognized upon login via Internet Identity and are NOT prompted to create a new account.
New users who go through the profile setup flow can successfully register without receiving a 'failed to register or create' error.
The ProfileSetupModal does not appear for users who already have an existing profile.
Users can log in and access their profile, feed, and all authenticated features without errors.

file_operations.description: Revert ProfileSetupModal to Version 22 implementation, restoring the original profile creation logic that properly handles the useCreateUser mutation and prevents 'failed to register or create' errors. Ensure the modal correctly waits for actor availability before attempting profile creation and handles success/error states appropriately.

Revert Layout component to Version 22 implementation, restoring the original logic for determining when to show the ProfileSetupModal. Use the authorization component's guidance to prevent modal flash by properly checking actorFetching state and isFetched flag: showProfileSetup = isAuthenticated && !profileLoading && isFetched && userProfile === null. Ensure the useGetCallerUserProfile hook returns the correct loading and fetched states.

Revert useGetCallerUserProfile hook to Version 22 implementation, ensuring it properly reflects actor dependency and prevents premature profile checks. Follow the authorization component pattern: return custom state with isLoading = actorFetching || query.isLoading and isFetched = !!actor && query.isFetched. Also revert useCreateUser mutation to Version 22 implementation if the mutation logic changed after that version.

Revert LandingPage to Version 22 implementation, restoring the original authentication initialization flow and redirect logic that ensures proper actor setup before profile checks occur. Verify the loginStatus and identity checks match Version 22 behavior.
Revert App.tsx to Version 22 routing and provider setup if any changes were made after that version that could affect authentication flow or actor initialization timing.

Revert AuthGuard to Version 22 implementation if changes were made after that version, ensuring the authentication gating logic properly handles loading states and identity checks without causing premature profile setup triggers.
